classification.mechanism: routing-surface authorization gap, not grader noise: the substance-correction utterance class (这个产品 spec 里写的流程是错的，帮我改对) had no description claim anywhere on the surface, while requirement-intent advertised the lexically nearest tokens (澄清 PRD / 需求不清楚); the cheap grader lands on the nearest advertised neighbor at 70% reproduction
classification.fix: dual signal per the measured oncall-round precedent and Anthropic skill-authoring guidance (description = the selection surface; positive trigger on the owner, negative trigger on the flip target): product-rd-workflow description gains the claim spec·PRD·需求文档实质内容写错要改对（substance 修正）; requirement-intent description Skip gains 已有 spec/PRD 实质内容写错要改对（substance 修正，非澄清）、多阶段交付计划 → product-rd-workflow plus a body boundary line. The always-on bootstrap (agent-context/session-start.md) is deliberately UNCHANGED: its entry-routing block is a curated digest, not a description mirror (established restart triggers are equally absent there), it contains no contradicting claim, and always-on growth is size-gated; the description surface is the routing authority. Severe-debt entrypoint growth offset in place: the instruction-grade tail parenthetical (re-entry guidance canonically owned by the body's Implementation entry / re-entry gate; zero lexical overlap with any of the 136 bank utterances — the only 4 grep hits are in grader-invisible why_expected/source metadata) was removed for a net -26 byte delta. Token preflight: 改对/写错/修正 unclaimed repo-wide; 实质 appears in requirement-doc-writer Skip in a distinct semantic domain (实质不清 vs 实质写错). Char budgets after edit: 414 and 450 of the 800 cap.

contents.recompute-aggregates.py: deterministic generator for aggregates-recomputed.json: enumerates all 26 authoritative raw round files + sidecars with per-file sha256, asserts every binding leg independently (all four legs, surface/catalog before==after, clean tree, rc==0), verifies each sidecar's round_file_sha256 against the raw round file, and asserts single HEAD/surface per arm (hardened post-r1a: trusting the derived binding_valid boolean alone would accept a hand-edited sidecar; hardened post-r2: expected inputs pinned up front — per-arm round counts and gapless numbering, case-id sets, arm HEADs, bank sha256s, runner sha256, and the per-skill description-line hashes binding every report to the exact wording at its arm's HEAD — so removed rounds or a consistently-bound substitute bank/surface fail instead of shrinking the aggregate), recomputes every cited tally (superseded/aborted dirs are hash-pinned in files_sha256 but excluded from authoritative aggregates by design) Post-r3 it additionally reconstructs the FULL description surface and graded catalog from the git objects at each arm's pinned HEAD (plus the pinned bank bytes) and requires every report AND sidecar surface/catalog hash to equal that ground truth — a consistently-edited report+sidecar pair can no longer self-vouch; fabrication now requires rewriting git history.
